title: Georgia Executive Orders (per-year file)
description: Executive orders issued by the Governor of Georgia in one calendar year. One file per year (data/<year>.json). metadata.governor names every Governor who issued an order that year, e.g. two in an inauguration year.

url.description: Link to the official order PDF.

bytes.description: Size of the PDF in bytes.

fetchedAt.description: UTC timestamp the PDF was downloaded (ISO-8601).

archiveUrl.description: Wayback Machine snapshot of the PDF, if archived.

issuedBy.description: The Governor who issued the order. Worked out from the order's date and the Governor's term (basis "date"); an order signed on an inauguration day is checked by hand (basis "verified"). null until a new Governor's term is confirmed.
